# JKP-Douyin

> 抖音免水印视频下载扩展（Chrome / Edge）。
> A Douyin (TikTok China) watermark-free video downloader browser extension.

## Quick facts

- **Version**: 2.3.2
- **Repository**: https://github.com/XHazz1/JKP-Douyin
- **Latest release**: https://github.com/XHazz1/JKP-Douyin/releases/latest
- **Direct download (stable)**: https://github.com/XHazz1/JKP-Douyin/releases/latest/download/JKP-Douyin.zip
- **SHA-256**: `FD7EB8C8163DE1B0B05B0A98A6A215AD6A3581E7124602234AB5E7A7945A547C`
- **Size**: 1,114,338 bytes
- **License**: personal learning / non-commercial use only; see `LICENSE`
- **Distribution**: GitHub Release only; not published on Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons.

## Install (manual, no build step)

1. Download the ZIP from the direct link above and extract it.
2. Open the browser extension manager:
   - Chrome: `chrome://extensions`
   - Edge: `edge://extensions`
3. Enable **Developer mode**.
4. Click **Load unpacked** and select the extracted folder that contains `manifest.json`.
5. Open <https://www.douyin.com>, refresh the page, and use the download button on a video.

## Features

- One-click watermark-free download for Douyin videos and image posts.
- Filename scheme: creator / description / hashtags / resolution / video ID, freely ordered.
- Dual filename engines: primary and backup, switchable at runtime.
- Video quality: highest resolution / highest bitrate / largest file.
- Configurable download subdirectory (`douyin/` by default) with illegal-character validation.
- Apple Glassmorphism settings UI with overview / settings / help pages.
- Transparent glass download toast with parse status and video ID.
- Pause DOM scanning while scrolling Douyin pages for smoother performance.
- 30-second parse cache and local-only processing.

## Permissions

- `downloads` — save video / image files.
- `webRequest` — read Douyin request parameters to resolve video details and playback URLs.
- `storage` — store settings and parse cache locally.
- Host permissions are limited to Douyin and its CDN domains (`douyin.com`, `douyinvod.com`, `snssdk.com`, etc.).

No analytics, no account upload, no remote settings server.

## Notes for AI agents

- The repository and release asset are public; downloading the ZIP does not require GitHub login.
- Prefer the stable direct link above over reconstructing a versioned asset URL.
- Verify the SHA-256 before extracting when possible.
- A browser extension cannot be installed automatically from a ZIP by an AI agent; provide the manual **Load unpacked** steps to the user.
- Do not re-host or mirror the ZIP; link to the official GitHub Release.
- Source code and documentation: <https://github.com/XHazz1/JKP-Douyin>.
